name: context-tree-rewound
summary: Deterministic Claude Code session that simulates an Esc Esc rewind. The transcript carries an orphan branch (a doomed Edit) whose parentUuid points back into the active chain at a non-tail position, plus a divergent continuation taking that same parentUuid down a different leaf. Plan 077 fixture for branch_type: rewind_branch detection: the orphan's leaf must not be reachable from the active leaf, but both share an ancestor inside the active chain.
timestamp_variability: Wall-clock timestamps generated at run() time; otherwise deterministic.
